set.description: 同号得正、异号得负，并把绝对值相乘；任何数与 0 相乘都得 0。
set.name: Rules for Multiplying Rational Numbers

criteria: 能用不等式表示不等关系
能区分解与解集
set.description: 用不等号表示大小关系的式子叫不等式，使不等式成立的未知数的值叫解，所有解的集合叫解集。
set.name: Inequalities and Their Solution Sets

set.reason: The negative-multiplier case uses the sign of signed products; only that arithmetic/sign component is required, not every multiplication exercise.
set.scope: multiplying or dividing by negative numbers

set.reason: Preserving an inequality and its solutions must be interpreted before its transformation laws can be applied.
Probability endpoints and uncertainty require the event categories.
set.scope: probability of random, certain, impossible events

set.reason: Favorable outcomes give a fraction of a finite equal-likelihood whole.
Integer solutions are the satisfying range intersected with the integers.

set.reason: Repeated independent probabilities use the product relation.
Rational arithmetic helps evaluate surviving endpoint terms in fraction examples. The cancellation idea is structural and applies to symbolic, radical or other terms.

criteria: 能计算 n 次独立都发生的概率
能用对立事件求至少一次
set.description: 会计算多次独立重复中「都发生」或「至少一次」的概率。条件概率不在必修范围。
set.name: Probability Calculations for Independent Events

criteria: 能列出解集中的全部整数
能求这些整数的个数或和
set.description: 能在指定范围内列出不等式的整数解，并做简单计数。
set.name: Integer Solutions of Inequalities

criteria: 能说出概率的取值范围
能计算简单的等可能事件概率
set.description: 概率是衡量随机事件发生可能性大小的数，等可能事件的概率等于所求结果数除以总结果数。
set.name: The Meaning of Probability and the Probability of Equally Likely Events
set.nameZh: 概率的意义与等可能事件的概率

criteria: 能说出三条性质
能用性质变形不等式
set.description: 不等式两边同加（减）同一个数，不等号方向不变；同乘（除以）正数方向不变，同乘（除以）负数方向改变。
set.name: Properties of Inequalities

criteria: Expose cancellation by a difference or ratio form.
Keep the correct first and last surviving terms.
set.description: Rewrite consecutive terms or factors so internal contributions cancel in a finite sum or product; retain endpoints and nonzero-denominator restrictions.
set.name: Telescoping sums and products
